_about: Whether vanilla agrees with ITSELF under each candidate projection of 080-spawn-egg-makes-a-mob, over the recordings on this box. Written by ci/mob-projection-search.py.
_cache_note: Confirmed first-hand 2026-08-19: a full T2 was run on this branch with RUSTMC_REFERENCE_CACHE=1, the run logged `reference-cache: HIT`, and the file count went 21 -> 22 while distinct recordings stayed at 17. With the cache on, taking a recording adds NOTHING to the reference-side N.
_draws: Five unseeded draws a spawned pig makes, from the jar: spawn yaw (EntityType.create@103) -> add_entity; sound variant (Pig.finalizeSpawn -> PigSoundVariants.pickRandomSoundVariant) , left-handed (Mob.finalizeSpawn -> setLeftHanded) and age (AgeableMob.finalizeSpawn -> setAge) -> set_entity_data; and the follow-range bonus (Mob.finalizeSpawn -> RandomSource.triangle on FOLLOW_RANGE) -> update_attributes, which is the one that does NOT reach a client. Attributes registers FLYING_SPEED via setSyncable(true) and FOLLOW_RANGE with no setSyncable call at all, so isClientSyncable() is false and update_attributes is 120/120 exact.
_gated_on: `--check` gates the SHAPE of each result — never / sometimes / always — and deliberately not the fraction. The fraction moves whenever a tree is made or deleted on this box, and a gate that reddens on housekeeping is a gate somebody turns off.
_method: De-duplicated by sha256 of the scenario's recorded block, because the reference cache serves one recording to several trees. Recorder schema held constant: one recording uses an older add_entity decoder and mixing it in makes every projection read 74% stable when the truth is 0% or 100%.
